map.2021 公式和旧版有何不同？: What is different about the 2021 formula versus the old version?
map.CKD 分期：按 eGFR 分 G1(≥90)–G5(<15) 并叠加蛋白尿 A: CKD staging: G1(≥90) to G5(<15) by eGFR with albuminuria A1–A3 layered on top, assessing chronic kidney disease progression and cardiovascular risk.
map.CKD-EPI 2021 取消了基于「黑人」的种族修正系数，采用统一算式，减少了: The CKD-EPI 2021 formula removed the race correction based on "Black" and uses a single unified equation, reducing estimation bias from racial assumptions; it also provides creatinine, cystatin C and combined algorithms, with the combined version being more accurate.
map.eGFR 低一定要透析吗？: Does a low eGFR always mean dialysis?
map.eGFR 计算（CKD-EPI 2021）：依据血肌酐（或胱抑素 C、二者联合）: eGFR calculation (CKD-EPI 2021): estimates glomerular filtration rate from serum creatinine (or cystatin C, or both), age and sex; the 2021 formula removed the Black race coefficient and is fairer.

map.不一定。G5 期（<15）且有尿毒症症状/严重并发症才考虑透析或移植；G3–G4: Not necessarily. Only G5 (<15) with uraemia symptoms or severe complications prompts dialysis or transplant; G3–G4 focuses on blood pressure control, glycaemic control, kidney protection and cardiovascular risk management, where following the trend matters more than any single value.
map.心肾综合征评估：合并心衰/冠心病时，eGFR 下降与蛋白尿提示预后更差，指导利尿: Cardiorenal syndrome assessment: when heart failure or coronary disease is combined, a falling eGFR with albuminuria signals worse prognosis and guides diuretic dosing and contrast agent use.

map.心血管患者为何要查肾功能？: Why do cardiovascular patients need kidney function tests?
map.心衰、冠心病常合并 CKD，eGFR 与蛋白尿是预后与用药（如造影剂、地高辛、降: Heart failure and coronary disease often come with CKD, and eGFR plus albuminuria are key for prognosis and for adjusting doses of drugs such as contrast agents, digoxin and glucose-lowering medication; when heart and kidney worsen together, multidisciplinary co-management is needed to avoid stacking nephrotoxic drugs.
map.采用CKD-EPI 2021(去种族)方程估算肾小球滤过率，结合白蛋白尿分期进行: Uses the CKD-EPI 2021 (race-free) equation to estimate glomerular filtration rate and combines albuminuria staging for CKD staging and cardiorenal risk stratification
